groups.description: The company this domain is modeled on: Kees de Boekhouder (Amsterdam, founded 2009), backed by Vortex Capital Partners since May 2022, with the sister company Founders for BVs.

links.title: Kees de Boekhouder — personal bookkeeper and app for freelancers (English)
links.relevance: The company's own proposition in English: a personal bookkeeper plus an app on a fixed subscription, 15 years, more than 10,000 entrepreneurs — the framing behind every customer persona.

links.title: Kees de Boekhouder — Vortex investment page
links.relevance: The investor's description: more than 10,000 clients, revenue CAGR above 25 percent, and the focus on leadership, organisational structure and professionalising the technology function.

links.title: Kees de Boekhouder finds new strategic partner in Vortex (24 May 2022)
links.relevance: The buyout announcement with the 6,500+ client count at the time and the founder and investor quotes that frame the growth horizons.

links.title: Vacature Head of Growth — Kees de Boekhouder (Top of Minds)
links.relevance: The growth mandate in the company's own words: from 10,000 to 20,000 clients with about 100 staff in a market of roughly 1.4 million freelancers.

groups.description: The public pages that the products, plans, add-ons and product bricks are modeled on.

links.title: Veelgestelde vragen — pricing, plans, cancellation and add-ons
links.relevance: The plan prices per legal form, the add-ons (partner return, payroll, bank connection), the first-fiscal-year rule and monthly cancellation, and the no-external-software policy that define the subscription stream.

links.title: Bankkoppeling — bank connection through Ponto
links.relevance: Which banks are supported, the four-times-daily sync, automatic matching, the €5 per account per month price and the 90–180 day re-authorisation behind the banking bricks.

links.title: Dashboard — real-time insight into revenue, costs, profit and VAT
links.relevance: The client dashboard that the financial dashboard and VAT position bricks mirror: revenue per quarter, cost categories, investments, profit and VAT to pay or receive.

links.title: Bookkeeper for starters — the Starters package
links.relevance: How starters are guided through KVK registration, the VAT number, the KOR and the startersaftrek on the same subscription — the Starting Entrepreneur persona's entry point.

links.title: Mijn Kees de Boekhouder — client login
links.relevance: The client web application where receipts, invoices, bank transactions and the dashboard live — the surface the client app bricks are deployed to.

links.title: Founders — prices for holding and operating companies
links.relevance: The sister company's fixed fees for a holding BV and a werkmaatschappij, covering corporate tax, statutory annual accounts and KVK filing — the BV director persona's plan.

links.title: Ponto — PSD2 bank connectivity by Isabel Group
links.relevance: The licensed PSD2 provider through which Kees connects business bank accounts; its bank coverage and consent rules set the constraints of the bank connection brick.

groups.description: How Kees grows through associations, service providers and client stories.

links.title: Partners — member benefits and referral discounts
links.relevance: The referral partners (BNO, DuPho, Kunstenbond, Stichting BOK, voordekunst, Unfair, Insify, BrightPensioen, DAS) and their member benefits that the Ecosystem Partner persona and the partner programme brick are modeled on.

links.title: Testimonials — client stories
links.relevance: Video and written stories from creative freelancers, a VOF of bakers and other clients — the source of the persona sketches and of the client-stories brick.

groups.description: Statistics and rules that shape the freelancer's tax obligations and the size of the market.

links.title: CBS — dossier zzp
links.relevance: Statistics Netherlands' figures on the number, sectors and income of zzp'ers, including the 2025 decline to 1.2 million — the market-sizing context for the growth mandate.

links.title: Handhaving schijnzelfstandigheid in 2026: wat wordt anders en wat niet (ZiPconomy)
links.relevance: How the Belastingdienst's enforcement of the Wet DBA continues in 2026 with a soft landing — the compliance question knowledge freelancers bring to their bookkeeper.

links.title: Belastingdienst — btw-aangifte doen en betalen
links.relevance: The tax authority's rules for filing and paying the VAT return, including the quarterly deadline that the review-and-file stream and the filing calendar are built around.

links.title: Belastingdienst — ondernemersaftrek
links.relevance: The official description of the zelfstandigenaftrek, startersaftrek and related deductions and the hours criterion that the year-end close and advice knowledge base apply.

links.title: KVK — kleineondernemersregeling (KOR) gebruiken
links.relevance: The €20,000 turnover threshold and consequences of the VAT exemption for small entrepreneurs — a first-quarter decision for starters and low-revenue creatives.
